description_en: It can perform structured recognition of foreign identity documents. Currently supported documents include resident ID cards from Vietnam, South Korea, India, and Bangladesh. Recognizable fields include name, date of birth, document number, and more
description_zh: 可对国外身份证件进行结构化识别，目前支持越南、韩国、印度、孟加拉居民身份证，可识别字段包括姓名、出生日期、证件号码等
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-international-idcard --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/sppytz/%E5%9B%BD%E9%99%85%E8%BA%AB%E4%BB%BD%E8%AF%81%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --country Vietnam --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeInternationalIdcard

parameters.help_en:
This field and the BODY field are mutually exclusive—you must specify exactly one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和BODY字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must specify exactly one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using an HTTP request, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Country name.  
Examples: India, Vietnam, Korea, Bangladesh
parameters.name: country
